supported_statements_at_exact_scope.statement: For real tanh-GELU, phi(a)=a/2+e(a) with even e. Thus phi(a)-phi(-a)=a. For a nondegenerate distribution symmetric about zero with the required finite moments, intercept OLS has slope 1/2. This invalidates the inference that a stable affine slope necessarily implies a narrow low-curvature activation range.

For actual saved q2_post, defining r=q-kappa*a-beta gives an exact coefficient decomposition. Applying decoded W2 preserves the signed real-arithmetic decomposition. Source code excludes the held source from fitted coefficients and source-fixed support calibration.

The absolute 40-case, five-block, four-step study reports source-held affine+27 uniform32 mean current-output relative SSE 11.27% versus 43.13% for the tested source-fixed group-only67 control. Their ideal projection MAC is exactly matched. This local result is consistent with the prior independent audit.

The approximately 54ms old-derivative, 4ms BF16 formation and 8ms application values refer to the existing unfused isolated repeated-row shape benchmark. The claim correctly does not report a complete folded-method speedup.

boundaries_and_precision_requests.boundary: The odd/even identity and half-slope theorem are continuous GELU results. Smooth2/BF16 casts, shared-scale Q2 and finite GEMM ordering do not automatically preserve either the paired-neuron cancellation example or bitwise folded equivalence. The claim already states this boundary; retain it beside any graph formula.

Odd/even cancellation is a valid competing explanation, not a measured explanation of Wan's affine benefit. Half-slope approaching OLS would test its explanatory sufficiency, not establish or falsify the algebraic identity itself. Actual even-remainder hidden and gated-W2 energies have not been measured by this claim.

Read 'stronger local representation than exact matched projection group pruning' as stronger than the specific tested source-fixed group-energy pruning control on these panels, not stronger than every possible group policy or optimal signed subset. The prior 10v,-10v,v counterexample shows even posthoc group-energy top-k is not an output-optimal oracle.

Exact MAC matching applies to the absolute affine+27/group-only67 and affine+54/group-only94 comparisons. The temporal linear+27/group-only54 comparison is close but not exactly equal, and matrix formation, QDQ, packing, memory and observation are additional costs.

Full-M denotes coverage of the old derivative statistic only. Approximation errors are on separately reported center128/uniform32 panels in two exposed image/seed clusters. They are neither all-token output errors nor video acceptance.

supported_statements_at_exact_scope.statement: The reviewed helpers replace only runtime._weight allocation/residency. The cached tensor is the original source.to(device,dtype,non_blocking=False).contiguous() result. Smooth/QDQ, F.linear, bias and gate/residual code are not replaced. Correctness depends on the immutable runtime/record/weight contract already described in the report.

The prior independent audit compared 18 phase trajectory/video hashes with historical dense: all matched. The new report's 18 videos, 72 scheduler hashes, 1600 linear calls, 1600 activation QDQ calls and zero cache misses per generation agree with that result. Warm all-resident reduces weight transfers to zero while FFN MAC reduction remains zero.

The current report places 75.172/75.372s original and 50.419/50.789s all-resident warm measurements on anonymous card B at matching source/phase, with 56,203,673,600 resident decoded-weight bytes and a sampled physical peak of 78,932MiB. The values and stated timing/memory boundary agree with the prior audit.

Reciprocal original/no-flush controls retain the direction on both card assignments. This challenges an explanation based only on card identity; it does not provide a full reciprocal all-residency experiment or a production speed confidence interval.

boundaries_and_precision_requests.boundary: The same-card A/B assignment is taken from the coordinator's new report and anonymized receipt SHA bindings. The prior independent raw-JSON audit checked local-index reciprocity but did not inspect a durable private host/card identity chain. This follow-up does not newly authenticate private mapping or claim an independent second receipt inspection.

There are six fresh processes with three videos each but only two exposed image/seed clusters, source0/42 and source12/54. Those 18 technical runs are not 18 independent quality scenarios. Full-resident versus FFN-resident lacks reciprocal card repetition and cannot isolate the marginal attention-residency effect from their cross-card difference.

Wall covers pipe.generate through the following synchronize, including common trajectory hashing and video encode/save, excluding assets/imports/pipeline construction. FFN CUDA events cover infer_ffn including attention-output residual addition, norm/modulation and Q1/Q2, but exclude later gate/residual writeback. Neither figure is pure GEMM time.

The 78,932MiB value is a two-second sampled physical peak including allocator reserved memory, not a continuous upper bound or live tensor byte count. The benefit is coupled to the measured 80GB capacity and cache population/cold-state cost.

Reduced transfers and removed explicit flush are directly counted or source-defined; the internal allocator backend and per-cause synchronization/copy trace were not measured. Avoid claiming that all _weight host wall is PCIe transfer or attributing the entire total-wall delta to a single allocator mechanism.
